patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff does not apply to the ARVO workspace and is unrelated to src/libopensc/card-cac1.c. The authoritative 18640-fix image runs the original PoC clean, but it does not execute the instrumented cac_cac1_get_certificate chain on that input, so the rooted required assertion remains not_exercised on the fixed side.

nodes.description: In the terminating branch, `left -= len;` subtracts the same final dispatched request length from the remaining-space counter before breaking out of the loop.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable trace shows request_len_dispatch.request_len == break_subtract.subtracted_len == 207 on the last iteration.

nodes.description: The post-subtraction `left` value from the terminating branch is the same remaining-space state consumed by `r = size - left` when the final copy length is computed.
At `memcpy(*out_buf, buf, r)`, the final copy length `r` exceeds the fixed 4096-byte stack buffer `buf` and therefore overreads it.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable trace shows copy_sink.copy_len=4240 while copy_sink.stack_buf_size=4096.

edges.description: The last request length dispatched to the APDU loop is the same `len` the terminating branch subtracts from `left`.
The remaining-space value after the terminating subtract propagates unchanged into `r = size - left`.
The computed final copy length `r` is passed unchanged to `memcpy(*out_buf, buf, r)`.
